ruleDefinitions.name: Phishing Pattern ISO in Archive
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects cases in which an ISO files is opend within an archiver like 7Zip or Winrar, which is a sign of phishing as threat actors put small ISO files in archives as email attachments to bypass certain filters and protective measures (mark of web)

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Winrar\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\7zFM\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\peazip\\\.exe$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\isoburn\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PowerISO\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ImgBurn\\\.exe$")))
